consequence.statement: No operational consequence for cert-manager users; this is a testing infrastructure maintenance change.

original.statement: Kind testing infrastructure images were updated to include Kubernetes 1.33 node image support.

decision.reason: [ev-eb95ba454b0b] files this under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)" and says only that the kind images now include the Kubernetes 1.33 node image. It names nothing that fails, gets rejected or stops being honoured, and no setting or default that an operator would see change. So "none" (informational) is the best-supported consequence. Confidence is low because the evidence never says outright that there is no impact. The "testing infrastructure" label comes from the section heading and from what kind images are, not from an explicit statement.
